newsitem.title: UK: Summer torpor dulls Europe cotton at week's end.
newsitem.headline: Summer torpor dulls Europe cotton at week's end.

text.p: A sharp increase in New York futures on Thursday failed to stir Friday's European raw cotton markets from seasonal torpor and a strong dollar further dulled spinner buying interest.
Few mills seemed to be seriously considering adding to inventory just now and sporadic price-testing inquiry centred on most competitively priced growths available for September-October shipment.
